name: luz (d00m-gui)
description: @d00m-gui/luz 0.5.0 translated onto the t-* vocabulary: scheme-tinted soft fills over outlines, depth-shifted nested surfaces, pill badges, boxed field groups, segmented tabs, notice-style toasts — troopy's feel. luz's OKLCH ramp maths cannot run per-palette, so depth is approximated with decaying color-mix() steps of --t-text into --t-canvas, enumerated over three nesting levels like luz's own _depth.css.
notes: Translation, not a vendoring (luz is distributed as a release tarball, not on npm; its component CSS depends on generated OKLCH ramp tokens that do not exist per tailor palette). Known deviations from upstream, deliberate: list rows do not end-align their last child (luz gotcha 14), row/table hover uses the palette's --t-selection instead of luz's near-black --table-hover-bg (gotcha 13), warning ink is mixed 55% toward --t-text so orange shades stay readable (gotcha 25). Light palettes get surfaces slightly darker than the page (the dark-mode depth direction) — accepted approximation.
